description: This file implements the ActiveSessions class, managing active CDM sessions with creation, retrieval, and removal functionalities. It includes thread safety mechanisms and interacts with session objects and external components.

classes.name: ActiveSessions
classes.description: Singleton class managing active CDM sessions with thread-safe create, get, and remove methods.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ActiveSessions.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::create
methods.description: Creates a new CDM session with provided parameters and adds it to the active sessions map.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::get
methods.description: Retrieves an active session matching the key ID if available, incrementing its reference count.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::remove
methods.description: Removes a session from active sessions, decrementing reference count and deleting if zero.
